notes.title: Version 0.2.5 Endless Mode and more
notes.content:
New Endless Mode:
[list]
[*] You can get all the power-ups for all the elements at the same time.
[*] There is no time limit, every 1 hour you earn a gold star. How many stars can you get?
[*] The monsters and bosses will be random after a certain period of time.
[*] You can upgrade specific elements, get more orbs, change attacks and more when you already have all the elemental power-ups.
[/list]
New Elementless Special Attacks:
[list]
[*] Now each special attack is different at the beginning of the game
[/list]
Interface and game improvements:
[list]
[*] Music and sound adjustment is improved with sliding bars
[*] Mimic can now give HP
[*] New ghost quest
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Spelling correction
[*] Fixed trap special not doing damage
[*] Optimization of some animations
[*] Other general fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Early access version is available
notes.content:
What is available in this version?
[list]
[*] More difficulty levels
[*] Shop with elemental effect upgrades and forbidden upgrades
[*] Achievements
[*] 2 new elements, ice and wood
[*] The progress of the demo version is not lost
[/list]

You can access new game features to extend the gaming experience early and participate in future improvements.
